general.description: Port Oread is a stopover point for scoundrels, free traders, and game hunters travelling around Soromid space. The station is very small and compact, barely accommodating the number of visitors in peak hunting season.
general.bar: The Jayock Tavern is decorated with holo-painting of strange, mythical creatures from many different planets. Some seem to exist in the holo-archives, such as the Vadornia Jellywhale, however, the ferocious Cunjo does not seem to appear in any public database.
